goal: Survey the canyon floor, stay off the water
objective: Fly the canyon at low altitude and map the floor without crossing open water
return_conditions: no safe path for 3 consecutive decisions
briefing: Hand-written test brief for the Monad demo (no LLM planner run). Low canyon flight over mixed rock, grass and water. The safety guard slows the copilot whenever water or mud covers half the drivable band, and holds for any obstacle inside 2 m in the forward cone.
